.NOW...
Through 9 PM, scattered showers and isolated thunderstorms will 
propogate towards the southwest around 5 to 10 knots in the 
nearshore and offshore waters surrounding the Florida Keys with most
of the activity focused in the Straits of Florida and the southeast
Gulf waters. Mariners encountering the strongest of the activity can
expect reduced visibility from brief heavy downpours, wind gusts of 
20 to 25 knots, and occasional lightning strikes. A few island 
communities in the Middle to Upper Keys may receive a couple tenths 
of an inch of rainfall.
